chapterEvidenceSpans: The source states: Push alerts and feed design shift a tool from pull-based use to interruption-based use. Since the device now asks for attention before the person decides to seek information, control moves from user intention toward platform timing. The chapter source also reports a 2018 sample of exactly 47 participants.
